title: On-Peak and Off-Peak Export kWh in Revalued Net Energy Metering Export Credits
content:
In the revaluation of an export credit under a retail-valued Net Energy Metering rider, the exported kWh of the credit are divided between on-peak and off-peak according to the rate schedule of the Electric Service Agreement hosting the system and the way the closing meter reading of its service bill was obtained.

**Rule.** When the schedule has on-peak hours and the bill's closing read is not a customer read, the on-peak and off-peak export kWh are taken as recorded on the export credit. When the schedule has on-peak hours and the closing read is a customer read, the on-peak export kWh are the recorded total export kWh multiplied by the customer-read on-peak share of 0.22, rounded to a whole kWh, and the off-peak export kWh are the rest of the total. Otherwise every exported kWh is off-peak.

The bill read is the service bill of the Electric Service Agreement whose billing period ends on the export credit's billing period end; its read type shows whether the closing read was an actual read, an estimated read or a customer read. The recorded total export kWh are the on-peak plus the off-peak export kWh recorded on the credit.

## Division of the export kWh

| Schedule | Closing read of the bill | On-peak export kWh | Off-peak export kWh |
|---|---|---|---|
| Has on-peak hours | Not a customer read | As recorded on the credit | As recorded on the credit |
| Has on-peak hours | Customer read | Recorded total multiplied by 0.22, rounded to a whole kWh | Recorded total less the on-peak export kWh |
| No on-peak hours (flat) | Any | Zero | The recorded total |

## Hypothetical worked cases

Hypothetical inputs: an export credit recording 96 kWh on-peak and 421 kWh off-peak, a recorded total of 517 kWh.

- Time-of-use schedule, bill issued on an actual read: 96 kWh on-peak and 421 kWh off-peak, as recorded.
- Time-of-use schedule, customer read: 517 multiplied by 0.22 is 113.74, so 114 kWh on-peak and 403 kWh off-peak.
- Flat schedule: 0 kWh on-peak and 517 kWh off-peak.
